title: Block Hours of a Remote Support Session — TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours
content:
**Session figured.** The session figured is the one on the client's ticket most recently resolved to the prepaid-block route with remote labor, its date being that resolution's date, as the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history records it; every remote session is priced from its own ticket's records alone. Resolutions are stamped to the minute; where a business-hours and an after-hours resolution carry the same minute the after-hours one counts as more recent, where two resolutions of one class carry the same minute the one with more billable minutes counts as more recent, and where they also record the same billable minutes the one on the higher ticket number counts as more recent; a ticket is resolved once, so the ticket number ends every tie. When the client has no such resolution, or the block's ledger already carries a remote-support draw for that ticket, no remote session is figured.

**Block hours.** A remote session on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours draws its billable minutes, rounded up to the size's billing increment and never fewer than the size's remote minimum, divided by 60, at the size's technician ratio and with a multiplier of 1, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour. The minutes drawn are settled first and the block hours are taken from them; the block hours are rounded once, at the end.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, on a TimeBank 10-Hour Block: 30-minute increment, 30-minute remote minimum, technician ratio 1.0)

| Billable minutes | Minutes drawn | Block hours |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 30 | 0.50 |
| 45 | 60 | 1.00 |
| 95 | 120 | 2.00 |

Tie case: two remote resolutions stamped at the same minute, one in the after-hours class and one in the business-hours class: the after-hours one is the session figured.
